$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFBD (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
Procedures (arrivals, departures, special VFR, radio failure) were then structured by hand from the English column of the text pages; what the chart only draws is not recorded.
name: Bordeaux - Mérignac

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, procedures structured by hand

service.atsHours: H24 - Aéroport de BORDEAUX Mérignac - BP 70116 - 33704 Mérignac Cedex (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

arrivals.note: aircraft bound to Bordeaux-Merignac and operating in uncontrolled airspace must call Merignac TWR 3 minutes before overflying the entry points

transit within the Aquitaine FIS: the flight information given on Aquitaine Information to VFR flights in class E and G airspace can be interrupted without notice; in that case each transit of class D airspace must be cleared with Aquitaine Approach, sector BW 129.880 or sector BE 119.275

vacating by the inactive runway is considered effective once the aircraft has crossed the wildlife control way; it is subject to ATC clearance and prohibited by night or by day when the RVR is below 800 m

departures.note: for flights to the south-west, because of TMA 1.1 whose lower limit is 1000 ft AMSL, the default exit point is S; the exit by SW is possible only on request and ATC clearance, at the altitude given by ATC
pilots are reminded of the proximity of the Le Barp LF P 5 area and must adapt their navigation accordingly

routes.use: except particular ATC clearance, these routes are followed in special VFR conditions and in VMC for environmental protection; they are two-way, usable for departures, arrivals and transits
routes.altitudeNote: except particular clearance, an overfly altitude of 1500 ft AMSL is respected on all routes (except the exit by SW, see the departure procedure)
routes.legend: -- visibility of at least 1500 m; == visibility of at least 3000 m

tracks.tracks: NA -- NW; NA == N; NA == NE; SA -- SW; SA -- S; SA == SE
EA -- N; EA == NE; SA -- SW; SA -- S; SA == SE
EA -- N; EA == NE; OA -- SW; OA == S

withAts.nightVfr: radio contact with Aquitaine Approach is compulsory before entering class D airspace

radio.failureOnArrival: before the clearance to enter the CTR, do not enter it; inside the CTR, before the clearance to join the traffic pattern, leave the CTR by the most suitable VFR route; after the clearance to join the pattern, continue to land as cleared
radio.failureOnDeparture: before take-off do not take off; after take-off leave the CTR following the last clearance (route and altitude)

notes: Compulsory Airport handling service: see TXT 03 Engine tests should have been carried out before taxiing request.
Areas K/J: Aircraft departing under VFR flight rules also contact ATC to request startup clearance, which may include a taxi hold, before leaving their parking position or the refueling station.
From 1st APR to 31st OCT, due to ACFT stands congestion, obtaining a stand is subject to a request before the departure, to the AD operator SA-ADBM via the ground handling company.
This procedure does not apply to based ACFT, State ACFT and HEMS.
Gliders and ULM prohibited within the CTR.
Training flights are under restriction (see AIP: AD 2 LFBD.21.4.1.3).
Air navigation hazard Confusion risk between thresholds 05 and 11 due to their proximity.
Paradropping activity NR 312: see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM activity NR 9011, 9026, 9380 and 9497: see AIP ENR 5.5 Free flying winch launch activity NR 905: see AIP ENR 5.5 special VFR conditions.
Voir / see AIP AD 2 LFBD.6 Péril animalier / Wildlife strike hazard: de / from SR-30 à / to SS+30.
